tagline: Fund fan ideas with clear rules.
intro: Pool testnet USDC for ads and fan goods. A campaign contract holds contributions, limits payouts, and makes refunds claimable when funds remain.
projectSub: Ads, goods, and cafés with visible funding rules.
emptyTitle: Our first projects are on their way
emptyBody: Projects will appear after their plans and funding rules have been reviewed. No campaigns are accepting funds yet.
previewNote: This is a local product preview. No contract has been deployed and no contributions are being collected.
rulesSub: These testnet examples show the contract rules and transaction record for each campaign.
rule1Body: Contributions go to the campaign contract, not directly to an organizer wallet. If the goal is missed or funding is stopped, supporters can claim refunds.
rule2Body: The budget caps each purpose and recipient. A separate reviewer must approve a payout before the contract sends it.
rule3Body: After settlement, supporters can claim unused funds in proportion to their contributions. Every transaction is public on Arc Testnet.
footer: Made for fans. Guided by shared plans.
organizer: A fictional project by LUMI Together
storyTitle: A little light for a special day
story: Imagine a birthday message brightening a Seoul station, and a small café corner where fans can leave their wishes. This fictional project shows how a shared plan, a fixed budget and clear refund rules come together on FanPot.
noFigures: Live funding and supporter counts will appear only after a real contract is activated.
notReady: Contributions are unavailable in this preview.
noSupporters: A space for everyone who joins. No supporters yet.
noUpdates: The first update will be shared here.
noLedger: No deployment or transaction records exist for this preview.
privacyHint: Amounts can be hidden from the FanPot supporter list. Blockchain transactions remain public.
meBody: Wallet connection and personal refund views are in development. No wallet is connected and no funds have been requested.
proofBody: The Arc Mainnet factory is deployed and its receipt and configuration are public. No Mainnet campaign or contribution has been verified yet. Wallet actions are paused while MetaMask reviews a warning for this domain.
helpTitle: A shared plan, from start to finish
helpBody: FanPot uses USDC on Arc. Participation will require a compatible wallet, a token allowance approval when needed, and a separate contribution transaction. Names and display preferences require an optional wallet login signature. Never send tokens directly to a campaign address.
privacyBody: The default is Anonymous with the amount hidden on the supporter list. Nicknames and social handles belong in the database, never onchain. Public transactions may still be linked through timing or a known address. This local preview has no user database or analytics.
termsBody: This development preview does not accept contributions. The MVP limits are 100 USDC per project and 20 USDC cumulatively per wallet per project, with a 0% platform fee. Network costs are separate. Funding success does not establish that an advertisement was delivered. Production terms and operating arrangements must be completed before a real pilot.
